verified.text: catch them standing in the spray before the stun lands, the armor strip makes the concoction hit far harder
the concoction's self detonation is lethal, cook it to deny yourself when the gank has you dead
start brewing before the teleport and land with the stun fully cooked, only when you are first to the fight
chemical rage is a basic dispel on cast, wipe damage over time, slows, blinds, and roots off yourself
chemical rage disjoints projectiles on activation, pop it as the spell or attack flies at you
the greed multiplies bounty rune gold, contest every spawn or quietly fund his lead
blink disjoints any spell or attack projectile already flying at him
mana void is not just an execute, the splash off a drained pool shreds the clump and the stun cuts channels
tap the treads to intelligence before every blink and back to agility after, the mana saved adds up fast
roots and leashes stop the blink cast entirely, hold one ready for him
the blink particle trail always floats the direction he traveled, read it and cut the angle
never hug an out of mana teammate late, they are the bomb his mana void detonates
shuriken bounces to tracked targets, open on a creep so it reaches the distant hero
dust reveal and slow linger after leaving the radius, euls or lotus dispels it
euls, manta, lotus, greaves, disperser all dispel track, so do allied dispels like aphotic shield
track gold makes even trades pay, a 1 for 1 is really 1.5 gold for 1, don't coinflip fights into bounty
essence distiller gives true sight on the debuffed target, it sees shadow walk
cinder brew soaks the enemies and slows them, magic or pure damage lights the soak and the burn runs longer
the fire stance crit is rolled the moment the swing starts, swapping into fire mid swing never crits that hit
auras ride whichever brewling currently leads, the order runs earth, then storm, then fire as each falls, and brewmaster walks back out wherever that body stands
the earth brewling's demolish passive shreds buildings, it is the siege body, push every objective behind it
the storm cyclone outlasts the split itself, and it holds creeps and summons in the air far longer than heroes
storm dispel magic shreds summons, illusions eat the full damage, clones, tombstone zombies, and ward type bodies are the exceptions
kill the fire brewling first, it swings the hardest and burns everything near it, deleting it strips most of the split's damage
primal split has a long cast time, instant silences and hexes land first and cut the combo down to the split alone
double edge costs no mana at all, spam it as the free nuke for pushing and wave clear
stampede speeds every allied hero and summon on the map, and every stampeding body applies the slow
hitch a ride makes the carried ally fully invulnerable, damage, debuffs, even the chrono arena cannot touch them
flak cannon, glaive, and split shot splashes only trigger the return when centaur is the primary target
nyx carapace reflects the return off a plain right click, auto attacking him just hands him free stuns
silver edge breaks the return passive and caps his move speed, the stampede escape dies under it
death pact can eat an enemy creep or your own skeleton archer, it heals him and pads his max health
skeleton archers copy his attack range exactly and swing for a share of his attack damage, both track his stats live
the archers spawn the instant skeleton walk drops and they never move, aim the walk exit to perch them on cliffs for scouting vision
cast skeleton walk mid channel without breaking it, strafe and death pact cast during the walk keep the invis, attacks and item use pop it
the shard barrage arrows fly with true strike, carry every attack modifier, and still fire while clinkz is disarmed
dispelling strafe off clinkz is wasted effort, the skeleton archers keep their share of the buff
damage block never blunts skeleton archer shots, their hits ignore it entirely
blink forward after the opening swipes to land the final starbreaker stun on top of a target
solar guardian stun pierces bkb, debuff immune enemies still eat the landing
once airborne she is invulnerable and hidden, nothing interrupts the landing, damage lands just before the stun
silence cannot cancel a started starbreaker, stuns, sleeps, and fears all can
nyx walks into solar guardian with carapace up and reflects the whole landing
devour only pays the bonus gold when the digest buff runs out, budget it as unreliable income
the ult silences, dispels the target on cast, and freezes their health so every heal source fails
self cast the scepter ult and it never curses you, you just walk around wearing the doom as an aura
click him before the fight, the devoured spell swaps his kit, a hidden war stomp or the wolf aura flips the engage
if he opens with the burn and holds no devoured cancel, tp out fast, the burn is his only lockdown
breathe fire cuts total attack damage including bonus damage from items, use it early in the fight
corrosive breath burn works on towers, the dot is the whole early push package
the transform itself is the gank, nobody respects the instant ranged stun out of knight form
silver edge and viper strike carry the break, dragon blood regen goes with it
vessel, skadi, ice blast, doom, even withering mist all cut the dragon blood regen
midnight pulse chews trees in a huge aoe, it burns sprout and knocks a tree dancing mk off his perch
midnight pulse deals full damage through bkb and debuff immunity, bkbd targets still melt in the zone
spawn multiplied eidolons before a solo early black hole, the channel alone doesn't have the damage
black hole silences on top of the stun, abaddon can't manually pop borrowed time and ursa can't enrage out
primal roar, global silence, overgrowth, and rubick steal all cancel hole through debuff immunity, count them first
walking away from a close range enigma eats an event horizon slow, respect the innate when disengaging
blade fury does not interrupt his channeling, spin mid tp and the escape channel holds
casting the spin is a basic dispel, the debuffs riding him wipe off as the storm starts
the storm negates his own attack damage, the spin is the damage and the sword waits it out
mid omnislash he still casts items and spells, the spin alone is locked out of the slash
the slash hunts a short radius around him, outrun the jump range and the chain cuts early
the healing ward dies to one hit and heals their whole team, kill it the moment it lands
split earth carries one of the longest windups around, bait the dodge in lane by canceling the cast, or drop it at your own feet to stun chasers without turning around

edict explosions follow leshrac and land on anything near him including towers, fewer targets means more hits each, hug the edge so the tower eats every blast and skip the right clicks to keep it on the creeps
edict keeps exploding around his corpse after he dies, dying mid siege still cracks the tower
edict and pulse nova both hit invisible and fogged units, chase the invis runner on a predictable path and the explosions draw him for you
lightning storm's heavy slow holds them in place, bolt first and split earth lands clean
split earth is among the easiest stuns to sidestep, the windup telegraphs it, a small sidestep or a step back dodges the rocks
dispel leshrac while the scepter nihilism runs and the whole ethereal aura collapses on the spot
the sacrifice innate eats an allied creep, its health becomes his mana and he pockets the experience bounty
frost shield blunts right clicks and instant attacks of every kind, spell damage and tower shots pass right through
frost shield lands on creeps, ward type bodies, and every tower and building, shield the objective under siege
the sinister gaze drag ignores pathing, victims walk straight over cliffs and terrain, pull them off the high ground or onto your side of it
sinister gaze is a hard disable in practice, the victim cannot act, self casting any save is off the table while it runs
spell block only swallows the first chain frost hit, the orb keeps bouncing and keeps growing after
the gaze drag reels you a long stretch toward lich, getting caught means walking straight into his team, keep your distance before it starts
frost shield and the gaze drag both wipe off with a basic dispel, carry one against him
rage's debuff immunity prevents the tormentor's damage reflect
infest applies a rare dispel that also wipes buffs, infesting right after a rune loses the rune buff
ghost scepter, force, blink, and shiva's kite him, a tp scroll saves you until the basher lands
break shuts off ghoul frenzy and feast together, silver edge, khanda, and viper strike carry it
ground cast earth spike reaches well past the cast range and threads between bodies to catch the clump
hex instantly destroys most illusions, ignore the flood and frog the real body
mana drain grants true sight on the target but no shared vision, fog still snaps the link
finger still stacks the bonus damage if the victim dies within three seconds, spend it early in the kill
earth spike ignores linken spheres and lotus orbs regardless of targeting
the drain link snaps on entering fog, ducking into tree fog cuts it far faster than outrunning the range
killing the bear pays nothing permanent, cull, flesh heap, and silencer int steal all whiff on it
savage roar is stun silence and mute in one, it stops bkb pops, borrowed time, and ursa enrage
shard roar dispels a cyclone or silence, cast it from whichever of you or the bear isn't disabled
shard fetch roots but never disarms, the fetched target keeps right clicking you
a suddenly full hp bear means a fresh spawn, kill the druid while he's bearless and his lane is over
minus armor melts the bear easiest, desolator and cuirass are the standard buys against ld
the blessing aura counts creep-hero bodies as heroes, brewlings and familiars ride the damage too
her night vision outranges nearly every hero, at the vision edge at night you see them and they do not see you
the orbiting glaive strikes carry true strike and ignore disarms entirely
glaive bounces count as spell damage yet damage block still trims every bounce
once the tier three falls the glaives bounce through every base structure, an errant bounce breaks your blink
summons and illusions tank the eclipse beams, feed bodies into the storm instead of your carry
the dispose throw counts as a stun, it breaks enemy channels mid cast
the dispose throw runs shorter uphill and longer downhill, map height bends the distance
the rebound leap still fires when the target dies mid dash, the corpse carries you
enemies cannot see the unleash pulses while she sits in fog, the damage still lands
roots and leashes stop the rebound cast entirely, hold one ready for her dash
a started rebound only stops for forced movement and knockback, she eats the stun and keeps flying
the starstorm follow-up meteor strikes the nearest target and hits fogged units, blind cast it to finish jukers
arrow damage and stun scale with travel distance and peak at half max range, skip the max range greed
the arrow instantly kills the first creep it hits, snipe big neutrals and siege creeps for free gold
the arrow grants flying vision while flying and brief vision on impact, use it to scout fog
leap crosses cliffs and impassable terrain, save the charges for real escapes over panic hops
moonlight shadow re-fades every ally invis for the full duration, stock sentries and dust before pushing
sprout grants flying vision around the point, scout fog jukes and cliff wards with it
sprout can be ground targeted, trap invis guesses and linken holders without direct targeting
canceling teleportation mid cast costs nothing, no cooldown and no mana, fake the rotation
wrath bounces a fixed count and each hit beyond the first adds damage, cast with vision across the map
the scepter wrath entangles every enemy it hits, a root and disarm bind scaling with the bounce
hold your disable for the end of the teleport animation, the cast is long and fully visible
sadist regen triggers on any unit dying, wards, buildings, denies, never illusions
death pulse lands on invis and fogged targets, no vision needed
ghost shroud blanks physical damage even from spells, omnislash and quill spray whiff
grave and false promise undo the scythe, sd and od banishes steal the window
he takes bonus magic damage inside ghost shroud, bait it before dumping nukes
vessel, skadi, and ice blast cut his healing, stack them before dueling him
use vendetta invis for positioning, land the impale on their stack, the spikes stun the whole line
carapace negates and reflects one damage instance per source, stuns whoever hit you
carapace can be cast inside vendetta without dropping the invis, run into their spell spam for free stuns
late game vendetta's invis and speed are for impale positioning, the bonus damage matters less
do not retaliate after his combo, the carapace reflects and stuns whoever damages him, just walk away
carapace reflects once per source on a short buff, bait it out then commit your damage
the brighter doppel illusion takes full damage, group it and bait them onto the fake
doppel dispels everything manta would, roots and silences lock the cast entirely
doppel forces your landing spot, it outranks glimpse and x marks repositioning
juxtapose multiplies off wards not buildings, serpent wards and tombstone feed the flood
rupture, viper strike, maledict survive doppel and tag the real one
mjollnir static shield rolls on every illusion swing, the army chips itself
attacking your own cog punts it a full stretch ahead, shove the wall where you want it
each cog is a ward body with its own vision, punch one onto a cliff to scout or deward for free
the hook latches onto any unit it touches, allies, neutral creeps, even roshan, ride it out of a gank
the cog shocks hit the bodies outside the ring and drain their mana, hug the middle to stay safe
he flares globally to snipe regen from anywhere, keep salve and clarity use quiet against him
the flare aims at a point, stand still a beat after you break vision and he has to guess where you went
keep re-aiming the landing point until the drop, the body lands wherever the last click pointed
fade bolt never bounces to bodies you cannot see, fog and invis break the chain
every bounce shaves the bolt's damage, open on the ranged creep so the last hit lands near full power
stolen spells inherit his quick cast point, slow windups like split earth snap off at his tempo
stolen spell cooldowns persist, dumping a stolen ravage for fun costs the next fight you steal it for
he always steals the last spell cast, dump a cheap cover spell right after the big one
ether shock reaches far past its cast range through the cone, cast it on the ranged creep to clip the runner
hex is instant cast, kills illusions on touch, and is a silence mute disarm break in one
hex has no cast point and out-ranges shackles, hex first in the gank order
drop the ward ring straight onto a hero, the circle blocks pathing and traps them inside
serpent ward attacks are not affected by damage block, block items do not mitigate them
shackles is channeled, keep a stun or silence ready to break the link off your ally
cast the sprint mid teleport channel, the channel holds and he lands already moving
the crush puddle and the haze trail both count as river, the sprint river bonuses pay inside them
the bash counter builds on creeps and never expires, buildings and wards never count or eat the proc
skull basher and abyssal blade bashes are dead on him, the game allows only the deep bash
the sprint buff wipes off with any basic dispel, purge him mid dash to cut the chase
the haze wipes off with any basic dispel, lotus, greaves, and manta strip it unless the undispellable talent is in
every dark pact tick is a strong dispel, it rips stuns off you
pounce leash cancels tps and most mobility, it functions like a root
dance regen drops when enemy vision touches you, use it to sweep their wards
never stun into dark pact, the ticks purge it, wait the spell out then disable
break kills essence shift and dance regen, silver edge break never dispels
bloodseeker owns him, no pact off rupture, thirst true sights the dance
dagger grants shared vision of everyone it hits, pings invis spots without true sight
the trail's free pathing lingers 1 second off the edge, cliff out behind you
dispersion reflects before reductions, armor and barriers never soften it
hug creeps when she shadow steps, the illusion damage is desolate only early
overload can load an attack already in the air, toss the long right click then cast and the hit lands charged
ball lightning disjoints projectiles the moment it is cast, zip as the stun flies to waste it
he counts as invulnerable for the whole flight, dot ticks, delayed stuns, and rupture damage all dodge mid zip
spells keep casting mid flight, remnant and vortex never wait for the landing
most of his damage is magic but it rides the right clicks, no landed hit means no overload payout
the zip drinks mana with every stretch, mana burn and drain starve him, anti mage feasts
god's strength multiplies strength damage only, raw green damage items do not get scaled
agh's storm hammer dispels ghost scepter and windrun in its aoe
agh's hammer ignores roots and leashes, the invulnerability walks him out of mars arena
the hammer is a disjointable projectile, any disjoint wastes the stun
basic dispels strip warcry off him and his team, only the shard version is protected
break shuts off great cleave, god's strength is an active buff break never touches
his own illusions only hold metamorphosis inside the transform aura, walk the real hero with the siege
sunder never touches debuff immune targets, a bkb on the low hero blanks the swap
sunder floors both bodies at a minimum share of max health, two low targets both rise to the floor
sunder sets health instead of dealing damage or healing, the swap still lands through heal cuts like ice blast
reflection copies item auras onto its illusions, your radiance and cuirass auras end up working for him
huge armor on a paper thin health pool, magic damage shreds him and every illusion he owns
avalanche pulses damage and stun in intervals, lead the target and the rocks catch walkers
toss disables whoever is thrown, and avalanche deals double damage to the tossed unit
debuff immune enemies can never be thrown, but you can still toss something at them
toss always grabs the nearest unit around tiny, allies included, mash it in a crowd
toss grabs units inside the grab radius even from fog, invisible units are the exception
the avalanche area keeps stunning, walking in late still eats the rocks
the shackle latch angle is computed from where the shot was cast, not where windranger stands when it lands
shackleshot latches fogged and invisible units, park a creep to pin the melded templar assassin as the second body
windrun dodges every incoming attack, towers included, even a projectile already in flight rolls the dodge on impact
focus fire grants no vision on the target, drop a quick powershot to hold the fogged runner in sight
focus fire strings many small hits together, damage block like vanguard or crimson guard eats the window
venomancer snakebite bursts on every attack she lands, it wrecks a focus fire commitment
arctic burn attacks burn a share of the target's current hp per second and slow it, hunt the fattest bodies
splinter blast leaves the primary target completely unaffected, only the flying splinters damage and slow
cold embrace cocoons an ally, healing it while blocking every physical damage instance
winters curse grows longer per enemy caught, taunted creeps add duration too, aim for the clumped wave
the frozen target and its taunted attackers are immune to enemy damage, only auroth and her units can hurt them
never stand near a cursed ally, the curse forces everyone in the radius to attack the frozen teammate
paralyzing cask bounces to units hidden in fog, the pinball keeps hunting unseen bodies
cask stuns hardest when the wave thins, pop the enemy once the lone ranged creep is the only bounce anchor
death ward can attack creep-hero bodies like brewlings, familiars, and the golem
toggling voodoo restoration never breaks the death ward channel, keep the heal running through the ult
maledict punishes health lost since it landed, healing yourself softens every later tick
one stun, silence, or banish ends the death ward channel, dedicate someone to the cancel
